items.statement: The submitted calculation uses the uniquely identified neutral compound-2 tetra(triflate) B2N6 molecule and verifies its complete structure before electronic-structure calculations.
items.expected: Identity evidence records CCDC 2512981 provenance, resulting atom count and C18H14B2F12N6O12S4 formula, charge 0, singlet multiplicity 1, deterministic symmetry/disorder handling, and verified B2N6 connectivity with all four B-O-SO2CF3 substituents retained.

items.statement: The ground-state structure is optimized and the excited-state calculation is based on a converged geometry with reproducible state-selection evidence.
items.expected: The report documents optimization convergence, states whether a frequency/Hessian check was performed, reports disorder/starting-structure/conformer coverage and limitations, and lists enough singlet states, including neighboring states or equivalent evidence, to justify selection of the fifth singlet or the method-corresponding dominant near-UV/visible state.

items.statement: The dominant compound-2 singlet excitation has the detailed source-reported SI energy.
items.expected: 3.8436 eV for the fifth singlet state carrying the dominant oscillator strength; the inconsistent main-text value 4.33 eV is not used as the numeric target.

items.statement: The dominant compound-2 singlet excitation has the source-reported oscillator strength.
The selected dominant compound-2 transition is principally HOMO-4 to LUMO and involves the N6-centred electronic system.
items.expected: The report identifies the source assignment as predominantly HOMO-4 to LUMO (217 to 222 coefficient 0.70241), relates it to N6-centred orbitals and electron-withdrawing triflate substitution, and acknowledges method-dependent orbital numbering/analysis.
